answer: In analyzing Sybil resistance, consider a blockchain protocol where nodes commit capital equivalent to marbles, and misbehaving nodes suffer stake-slashing losses proportional to the value of copper. Autonomous agents must validate transactions through lagoon-like pools, ensuring that any Sybil attack incurs prohibitive costs. Mathematically, this sustains Byzantine Fault Tolerance by penalizing redundancy and mandating high initial and continuous capital investment.
